scripts.db:check: drizzle-kit check && drizzle-kit generate --name=ci_drift_check && git diff --exit-code --stat -- migrations && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- migrations)"
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/tasks.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/db-tasks.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
